cases.title: Autonomous read-only input differential
cases.prompt: Run a bounded read-only assessment of captured Harborline requests. Rank candidates, establish baselines, try the smallest useful typed mutations, and classify each hypothesis from response differentials. Do not submit forms or invent authenticated requests.

expected.summary: Uses the assessment contract on captured read-only requests and identifies at least one supported input-handling differential with probe evidence.
acceptedGaps: POST-only form workflows remain out of this profile's experiment contract.

expectedDisposition.explanation: This profile exposes every required tool group within its sealed policy budget.

completionReport.executiveSummary: The bounded read-only assessment completed without a supported security finding. The sole file-read path mutation experiment was inconclusive; additional captured application endpoints could not be tested because the replay budget was exhausted.
completionReport.scopeSummary: Assessed captured traffic and visible unauthenticated login surface on http://127.0.0.1:3000 using the current identity. No forms were submitted and no requests were invented.
methodology: Reviewed captured in-scope traffic and current login-page DOM.
Ranked captured requests for contract-approved read-only replay families.
Ran one typed injection-signal experiment against the captured file-read path parameter and reviewed assessment progress.

observations.title: File-read path mutation did not establish an allowlist bypass
observations.detail: The captured file-read endpoint received two injection-signal path variants, both returning 404. The experiment classifier marked the result inconclusive because only one control-pair response changed, so this is not sufficient evidence of either an exploitable bypass or complete protection.

observations.title: Unauthenticated entry surface remained unsubmitted
observations.detail: The visible application surface was a login form with operator ID and password fields; no form interaction was performed under the read-only mission.

limitations: Replay budget was exhausted after the file-read experiment.
Captured candidates for cargo search, support preview, invoice resource access, integration preview, and CORS behavior were not exercised.
No authenticated workflow or multi-identity authorization comparison was available.
No evidence-backed draft vulnerability passed the finding quality gate; this does not prove the target is vulnerability-free.
recommendations: Restore a bounded replay budget and retest the file-read endpoint with a purpose-built resource-boundary family if approved.
Prioritize typed read-only checks of captured cargo-search, support-preview, invoice, and integration-preview endpoints.
Perform authorized multi-identity authorization testing before drawing conclusions about resource access controls.
Review the retained observations and close the listed coverage gaps before treating the assessment as exhaustive.
